python3 -c "
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import datetime

W, H = 612, 792
img = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), 'white')
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Use a default font (scaled) for title and date
def get_font(size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf', size)
    except Exception:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

title_font = get_font(36)
date_font = get_font(20)

title = 'Annual Financial Report'
date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime('%B %d, %Y')

def center_x(text, font):
    bbox = d.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    return (W - (bbox[2] - bbox[0])) / 2 - bbox[0]

d.text((center_x(title, title_font), 480), title, fill='black', font=title_font)
d.text((center_x(date_str, date_font), 400), date_str, fill='black', font=date_font)

img.save('screenshot.png')
print('screenshot.png saved')
" && ls -la screenshot.png
